question: Can an observed per-version bottleneck load select FIFO in clear regimes and replacement plus value density in overlap-prone regimes?
pressure_rule: After every complete source-release set, compute phi=max_e sum_i declared_bytes_i*1[e in P_i]/(capacity_e*version_period). Once an observed phi is at least one, enable safe replacement and value-density service. Before activation, use FIFO.
notes: All methods receive the same SQL objects, releases, topology, fixed shortest paths, capacities, installation rule, evaluation window, and post-execution score.
The pressure uses only fully released objects, fixed paths, positive capacity, and the declared version period.
The threshold one is the physical queue-balance boundary and was fixed before execution.
The gate is irreversible within one execution, which avoids service-rule oscillation.
